requirements.title: One self-hosted bot identity for the production Aphelion guild; native Windows Server 2022
Support, player reports, staff-created tickets, forms, category-specific permissions
Shuttle is a private, persistent, interactive ticket; no channel-unlocking chain
No AI in any ticket or any ticket-derived data pipeline
Join roles and allowlisted role restoration; no privilege resurrection
Simple configured reactions/responses and manually approved canned answers
Web dashboard plus Discord commands calling the same application operations
Separate AI chat, knowledge and lookup in explicitly approved non-ticket contexts
MediaWiki connector now; Wagtail only a future adapter
Local CPU inference initially; no cloud fallback or telemetry containing prompts
Newly adopted application projects are MIT; unresolved licensing is not silently approved
Extensible feature modules and external-service adapters without a microservice platform
Leave Discord/BYOND integration and its role ownership with the existing bot
No historical ticket import, but preserve current member eligibility during cutover
Meridian visual direction, accessibility, reduced effects, and no unverified asset copying
Backups, deletion propagation, auditing, service recovery, and rollback
Sophie (she/her), Community Services, with the latest neon chibi protogen asset set; no legacy human artwork in active branding
Branding is independent of AI; static assets/templates never create ticket or Shuttle AI paths
